posts.name: Shubha Kanta Biswal
posts.cooked:
Can i use Tilix Terminal during OPPE VM ?? like this one side OPPE VM and other side my own terminal ??

VM1918×1060 45.5 KB

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
We recommend to use tmux from inside the VM.

  • ssh once into the VM
  • run tmux (or tmux a if you already have a running session) to join tmux
  • Use tmux to split panes

This way, if you have a network issue (lets say while editing the script file, and you haven’t saved changes) you do not lose progress due to being logged out. You can simply ssh back in and do tmux a to resume your session.

Refer this.
